ownerStatement: Release Temp Save 0.1.0-experimental. I waive the static cycle bound for this version.
reason: Temp Save works once per FUNC + YES or FUNC + NO press, in the UI task and outside the audio frame. The dearest event, a reload while playing, measured 640,923 executed instructions in the emulator (at most 635,604 under a 1,000 message/s MIDI flood), against a 26,600,000 budget; no static count was made. The contributor's MKII runs cover the timed trial, Keep, a kept power cycle and Undo through the site's flow on the published package. Every other qualification stays required.
